name: Mount Wutai
description: Mount Wutai, in China's Shanxi Province, is a sacred Buddhist mountain ringed by five broad, treeless peaks. The north peak, at 3,061 metres, is the highest point in northern China. Forty-one monasteries dot the area, including Foguang Temple, whose Tang dynasty main hall holds life-size clay sculptures, and Shuxiang Temple, with its 500 statues set in sculpted mountain scenes.
